row.notes: Called once (0x141a77fbb), from the F1WorldActivityContainerViewModel command handler 0x141a77d60 (vtable 0x14572ac70 slot 10) on entrant_list_selected (djb2 0x22f71644; FeTile_Press_EraTile raises it with the pressed era tile's command), with the command's text. Walks the game setup modes of the container's mode (*(container+0x2f0); *(*(mode+0x88)+0x260) vtable +0x1d0 returns the setup-mode vector at +8..+0x10). For the first setup mode whose entrant setup modes (array at gsm+0x10, count gsm+0x70) list entrant_list (each entrant setup mode: list objects at +0x130, count +0x230, name *(*(list+0x28)+0x10)), it stores the setup mode's stat id (byte gsm+0x80) with 0x14245c440(&0x14604eac0, id) and the list's stat id (byte at the list object) with a tail call 0x14245c720(&0x14604eac0, id). The handler then calls 0x141a79480 (championship) and 0x1424b3640, which tail-jumps (0x1424b37fb) into 0x1424b2c90; its store at 0x1424b2ed1 fills the selected list (+0xe18) with the entrant setup mode's first list (+0x130[0]) when it is empty. The counts at gsm+0x70 and esm+0x230 are qwords; the 32 list slots are inline from +0x130 (V1007).
